articles.title: Crypto industry cheers Senate Clarity Act markup date as market structure push resumes
articles.snippet: The bill's progress follows talks on jurisdiction, consumer/developer protections, and stablecoin rewards, with crypto firms backing a yield compromise.

articles.title: ECB's Lagarde’s digital euro warning: Why Europe shouldn’t just copy the U.S. stablecoin model
articles.snippet: Lagarde warned that large stablecoins like Tether and USDC, which now dominate a $310 billion market, pose financial stability risks and could transmit stress to underlying asset markets during periods of turmoil.

articles.title: Stablecoins have their 'permission slip.' Now comes the hard part.
articles.snippet: Executives from MoonPay, Ripple and Paxos said at Consensus Miami 2026 that regulation has accelerated stablecoin adoption, but infrastructure, privacy and distribution remain major hurdles.

articles.title: Coinbase bulls point to crypto legislation and stablecoins after earnings miss
articles.snippet: Analysts say Coinbase’s long-term growth may depend more on stablecoins and U.S. crypto legislation than a rebound in trading activity.

articles.title: Exodus launches AI agent-focused stablecoin on Solana
articles.snippet: The crypto wallet company pairs the XO Cash token with software tools that let AI agents transact using preset spending controls and stablecoin payments.
